superconductor_composition.label: Superconductor composition
superconductor_composition.description: Al, Nb, NbTiN, Ta, TiN, NbN, Pb or reported composition; identify layer/component.

superconducting_gap.label: Superconducting gap
superconducting_gap.description: Reported Delta, including Delta/h where explicit. Do not infer from material or Tc.

critical_temperature.label: Critical temperature
critical_temperature.description: Reported superconducting Tc for the identified film/material.

film_crystallinity_measurement.label: Film crystallinity measurement
film_crystallinity_measurement.description: Named quantitative crystallinity/disorder metric and method; no universal metric assumption.

film_thickness.label: Film thickness
film_thickness.description: Thickness of a named superconducting or other film; identify layer.

surface_oxide_composition.label: Surface oxide composition
surface_oxide_composition.description: Reported surface oxide chemistry; do not infer stoichiometry from the metal.

surface_oxide_thickness.label: Surface oxide thickness
surface_oxide_thickness.description: Reported surface oxide thickness and measurement method.

surface_oxide_properties.label: Surface oxide properties
surface_oxide_properties.description: Other reported oxide properties, each with exact definition.

mean_free_path.label: Mean free path
mean_free_path.description: Reported mean free path; do not calculate from resistivity or purity.

purity.label: Purity
purity.description: Reported numeric purity or qualitative clean/dirty limit description.

junction_stack.label: Junction stack
junction_stack.description: Ordered junction material stack, preserving the paper's layer names.

junction_barrier_thickness.label: Junction barrier thickness
junction_barrier_thickness.description: Barrier thickness, distinct from electrode/native surface-oxide thickness.

junction_barrier_uniformity.label: Junction barrier uniformity
junction_barrier_uniformity.description: Named uniformity statistic or qualitative description, not an assumed metric.

junction_area.label: Junction area
junction_area.description: Reported area; do not multiply dimensions into an unreported area.

junction_critical_current.label: Junction critical current
junction_critical_current.description: Reported Ic for this junction/device, not inferred from EJ or resistance.

junction_fabrication_method.label: Junction fabrication method
junction_fabrication_method.description: Shadow evaporation or reported alternative; process conditions belong in fabrication steps too.

junction_geometry.label: Junction geometry
junction_geometry.description: Dolan bridge/Manhattan or another explicitly named junction geometry.

patch_bandaid.label: Patch bandaid
patch_bandaid.description: Explicit use, absence, material and implementation of patch/bandaid; silence is Unknown.

substrate_material.label: Substrate material
substrate_material.description: Silicon, sapphire or reported substrate; identify the component.

substrate_orientation.label: Substrate orientation
substrate_orientation.description: Si(100), Si(111), c-plane/a-plane sapphire or original reported orientation.

surface_roughness.label: Surface roughness
surface_roughness.description: Reported roughness; retain RMS/Ra/method/scan size rather than equating definitions.

interface_chemistry.label: Interface chemistry
interface_chemistry.description: Explicit metal-substrate/interface chemistry and interfacial oxides.

surface_treatment.label: Surface treatment
surface_treatment.description: HF dip/anneal/plasma or reported protocol; also preserve ordered process conditions.

tls_density.label: Tls density
tls_density.description: Reported TLS density with energy/area/volume basis; never substitute loss tangent.

device_geometry.label: Device geometry
device_geometry.description: 2D planar, 3D cavity or explicitly reported geometry; don't infer from qubit type.

cavity_dimension.label: Cavity dimension
cavity_dimension.description: Each named cavity dimension separately, retaining axis/component label.

participation_ratio.label: Participation ratio
participation_ratio.description: Electric-field energy fraction; name the lossy region and measured/simulated basis.

resonator_dimension.label: Resonator dimension
resonator_dimension.description: Each resonator length/width/gap separately with a precise label.

capacitor_pad_dimension.label: Capacitor pad dimension
capacitor_pad_dimension.description: Each pad length/width separately with a precise label.

capacitor_pad_separation.label: Capacitor pad separation
capacitor_pad_separation.description: Pad gap/separation, with component pair identified.

feature_dimension.label: Feature dimension
feature_dimension.description: Another reported feature size or spacing; retain its physical identity.

vortex_pinning.label: Vortex pinning
vortex_pinning.description: Explicit patterned holes or other pinning features; silence is Unknown.

josephson_energy.label: Josephson energy
josephson_energy.description: EJ, EJ/h or EJ/hbar; keep their representation explicit.

charging_energy.label: Charging energy
charging_energy.description: EC, EC/h or EC/hbar; keep their representation explicit.

ej_over_ec.label: Ej over ec
ej_over_ec.description: Reported EJ/EC only; never divide two separately extracted values to invent a result.

design_frequency.label: Design frequency
design_frequency.description: Target/design frequency range, distinct from a measured transition.

anharmonicity.label: Anharmonicity
anharmonicity.description: Reported signed anharmonicity and convention; negative values are valid.

capacitance.label: Capacitance
capacitance.description: Reported capacitance of the labelled element.

inductance.label: Inductance
inductance.description: Reported inductance of the labelled element.

coupler_design.label: Coupler design
coupler_design.description: Reported coupler circuit/implementation, with connected devices identified.

coupling_tunability.label: Coupling tunability
coupling_tunability.description: Fixed/tunable only when stated; do not infer from a SQUID alone.

coupling_strength.label: Coupling strength
coupling_strength.description: Reported g, J, g/(2pi) etc.; retain representation and device pair.

layout_topology.label: Layout topology
layout_topology.description: Grid/heavy-hex/modular or exact topology; don't infer from vendor.

other_design_choice.label: Other design choice
other_design_choice.description: Another explicitly named design decision, with no guessed default.

process_duration.label: Process duration
process_duration.description: Duration of this specific process step.

process_temperature.label: Process temperature
process_temperature.description: Temperature of this step, not device operating temperature.

process_pressure.label: Process pressure
process_pressure.description: Pressure with gas identity, static/dynamic mode and context retained.

process_gas.label: Process gas
process_gas.description: Gas composition, flow and purity as reported; quantitative flow may use other_process_parameter.

process_deposition_rate.label: Process deposition rate
process_deposition_rate.description: Reported deposition rate for the named layer.

process_angle.label: Process angle
process_angle.description: Evaporation/tilt/rotation angle with stated reference axis.

process_chemistry.label: Process chemistry
process_chemistry.description: Chemicals, concentrations and resist/developer/etch recipes; preserve original basis.

other_process_parameter.label: Other process parameter
other_process_parameter.description: Other explicitly named process parameter, with original units.
